checks.detail: Instructor dashboard shows all teaching features in a clear sidebar and no payment or revenue controls.
Floating assistant opens as a non-modal window; Gujarati question retrieves the correct batch-quiz guide and explicitly identifies retrieval-only mode.
Instructor course-creation form contains no price, discount or gateway fields.
Created a course in the UI, added a private video and duration, saved and reloaded; both persisted correctly.
Instructor roster loads owned course enrollments and actual completion progress.
Student submitted HTTP assignment; persisted receipt and awaiting-review status visible.
Student completed 3-question instructor quiz via UI. Backend result 3/3, 100%, persisted assessment.
Instructor read real submitted answer and saved manual grade 85/100 with feedback through gradebook.
Admin approved pending course; published list verified. User search, deactivation/reactivation of synthetic second student, and enrollment table worked without finance fields.
Student reopened submission after instructor review; own 85/100 score and exact feedback visible.
New course: instructor create/edit/submit -> admin publish -> student free enrollment -> lesson opened directly, no checkout.
390px student dashboard and floating Hindi assistant: scrollWidth=clientWidth=390. Correct role-filtered assignment article in Hindi. Final lazy assignment modal retains workspace shell.
Private notes generated from pasted HTTP text with explicit offline template label; saved note appears in private library. Unsupported video URL did not produce generated output.
Final production notes screen shows persistent transcript-required error and no generated output for a video URL without text.
Revision quiz lists both real enrolled courses and lesson scope. Selecting 3 produces exactly 3 questions, labelled offline template and practice only.
390px instructor workspace has no page overflow. Lazy quiz tool keeps shell visible; form fields labelled; 3-question draft count correct and offline review notice visible.
All three role dashboards fit 390px and 1440px without page overflow. Mobile admin overview shows real totals and all governance links.
Latest standalone Docker frontend renders catalog against isolated empty QA database; empty-state UI works without console errors.

Final build: instructor 1440px width equals scrollWidth. Quiz question edit/save/remove controls have accessible names; edited text persists in draft. Instructor login ignored an admin return URL and reached instructor workspace.
